interpretation: The event family is broad: 1,383 2022 parent episodes, 81,421 emitted states and 601 completed full-policy trades.
Continuation had a small gross tendency, but realistic 12bp cost already made every account policy negative.
The full sequential model predicted positive value for 50,991 2022 action rows, whose realized mean and median 24bp account returns were negative.
Full-sequence rank correlation was below the structural/location-only comparator and its one-slot account path was also worse.
Waiting and sequential evidence did not convert the first-interaction family into repeatable cost-after Core alpha.
Calendar 2023, official 2024-2026, ML rescue, risk and leverage remain closed.
